## Research Expertise

- Perovskite solar cells
- Tin and tin-lead perovskite photovoltaics
- Scalable photovoltaic manufacturing
- Vacuum-flash crystallization
- Blade coating
- Slot-die coating
- Charge-transport layers
- Self-assembled monolayers
- Photoluminescence and electroluminescence
- Quasi-Fermi level splitting
- Photovoltaic reliability
- Space photovoltaics
- Tandem solar cells
- Vanadium redox flow batteries
